lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for the Federated States of Micronesia through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 100% coverage of buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with data averaging 3 years old and 1% updated within the last 6 months.
